name: sintese-playmaker
description: Notices when there is enough parallelizable work, offers to run it with the agent CLIs you already have installed (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini/Antigravity, Copilot), and coordinates the workers through git worktrees and Lore. Commands to plan, run, review, merge, retry, stop and check a parallel run.

proactive.title: Proactive offers
proactive.description: Let Playmaker nudge Claude to offer parallel execution when many tasks are open. Turn off to use only the /sintese-playmaker:plan command on demand.

min_tasks.title: Open tasks before nudging
min_tasks.description: How many open tasks in the session task list trigger the nudge.

live_board.title: Live board
live_board.description: Open the Playmaker board in a pane beside the conversation when a run starts. /playmaker shows or hides it at any time.
